rows.commentary: 0.1: Kranti Gaud lands a length ball outside off, extracting no bounce as Kelis Ndhlovu misses a pull and the ball dies through to the keeper.
0.2: Kranti Gaud finds sharp bounce outside off, zipping past the bat as Kelis Ndhlovu swings for a drive and comes up empty.
0.3: Kranti Gaud loops it wide outside off, drawing a booming, unchecked swat from Kelis Ndhlovu that meets only thin air.
0.4: Kranti Gaud spears this full delivery directly into the stumps, meeting a crisp straight drive from Kelis Ndhlovu that rockets straight back down the pitch into the bowler's hands.
0.5: Kranti Gaud spears this delivery down the leg side as Richa Ghosh dives sharply to her right to rescue the errant wide.
0.5: Kranti Gaud targets a full length outside off, and Kelis Ndhlovu drives it firmly towards the cover fielder for a dot ball.
0.6: Kranti Gaud rounds the wicket to nip one back into the pads, wrapping Kelis Ndhlovu as a stifled appeal fades into the opening over.
1.1: Nandani Sharma lands a full delivery just outside off that feathers away, tempting Beloved Biza into a loose drive that beats the bat entirely.
1.2: Beloved Biza does not score off Nandani Sharma.

1.3: Nandani Sharma drops it full, and Beloved Biza stays balanced to effortlessly flick it into the deep mid-wicket region, sprinting hard for a sharp three runs while Gaud saves the fourth with a dive.
1.4: Nandani spears it in near-yorker length to trap Ndhlovu on the pads, beating the batter's attempted flick as the ball skids away toward the covers.
1.5: Nandani Sharma angles it in sharply from round the wicket, catching the edge of Kelis Ndhlovu's open bat face straight onto the pads.
1.6: Nandani Sharma delivers a length ball angling inward as Kelis Ndhlovu advances down the pitch, suffocating her workspace before she pushes it directly back to the bowler.
2.1: Dot ball from Kranti Gaud to Beloved Biza.
2.2: Dot ball from Kranti Gaud to Beloved Biza.
2.3: Kranti Gaud lands it full on the off stump, and Beloved Biza punches the drive crisply towards the cover fielder.
2.4: Beloved Biza does not score off Kranti Gaud.
2.5: Kranti Gaud digs it in sharply into the ribs, forcing Beloved Biza to duck beneath the venomous trajectory and safely evade danger.
2.6: Kranti Gaud lands it on a length and jags it back sharply, allowing Beloved Biza to tuck it into the backward square leg region for a single.
3.1: Nandani Sharma searches for control but pushes this length ball too far down the leg side, prompting the umpire to stretch his arms wide.
3.1: Nandani Sharma delivers to Beloved Biza, turning it square of the wicket to comfortably collect a pair of runs.
3.2: Nandani Sharma digs this delivery in short and high toward the stumps, forcing Beloved Biza to duck beneath the soaring trajectory as the umpire stretches out his arms.
3.2: Nandani Sharma serves it full on the line of off stump, and Beloved Biza calmly taps the ball away toward backward point to scamper through for a single.
3.3: Dot ball from Nandani Sharma to Kelis Ndhlovu.
3.4: Nandani Sharma pierces the defense of Kelis Ndhlovu, clattering the timber to dismiss her for a duck.
3.5: Leg byes off Nandani Sharma's delivery to Mugeri, 4 runs in all.
3.6: Nandani Sharma delivers a full ball angling in, and Mugeri deftly pushes it towards short cover to scamper through for a single.
4.1: Deepti Sharma offers width, and Mugeri-Tiripano carves the cut straight to the fielder at point.
4.2: Mugeri does not score off Deepti Sharma.
4.3: Deepti Sharma targets the stumps with a full delivery, and Mugeri attempts a cross-batted heave that cramps her before flying harmlessly toward midwicket.
4.4: Deepti Sharma delivers on a length outside the off stump, and Mugeri steps forward to carve the ball straight to the waiting cover fielder.
4.5: Deepti Sharma loops up a slower delivery that Mugeri-Tiripano safely negotiates back down the pitch to the bowler's hands.
4.6: Deepti Sharma loops one up on off-stump, allowing Mugeri to drop to one knee and sweep it cleanly away to the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
5.1: Arundhati Reddy tests the channel outside off with a fuller delivery, tempting Mugeri into an expansive drive that ultimately finds only thin air.
5.2: Arundhati Reddy cleverly takes pace off the ball to completely deceive Mugeri, prompting Richa Ghosh to fire a wayward shy at the stumps after the batsman misses.
5.3: No run for Mugeri off Arundhati Reddy.
5.4: Arundhati Reddy drops this length delivery angling in, and Mugeri-Tiripano flashes hard only to slash empty air underneath the line.
5.5: Arundhati Reddy drops it on a length, and Mugeri gets behind the line to dead-bat it firmly toward the covers.
5.6: Arundhati Reddy drops it full and wide, and Mugeri-Tiripano carves a thick slice past deep backward point to salvage the innings' opening boundary on the final ball of the powerplay.
6.1: Deepti Sharma loops a delivery into the stumps, and Biza immediately turns it toward the square leg fielder who cuts off any prospect of a single.
6.2: Deepti Sharma lures Beloved Biza into a false stroke, ending her stay at seven as Harmanpreet Kaur snaps up the catch.
6.3: Deepti Sharma loops it up to Mayers, who lofts the delivery crisply down the ground to find the boundary rope at long-off.
6.4: Deepti Sharma arrows one straight through, beating Mayers on the turn as the ball skids away toward point.
6.5: Deepti Sharma loops it up with sharp inward turn, forcing Mayers onto the front foot to safely block.
6.6: Deepti Sharma tosses this final delivery generously on off stump, patted securely toward short covers to cap off the over.
7.1: Arundhati Reddy drops it full and angled into the pads, allowing Mugeri to clip the ball neatly toward short mid-wicket for a single.
7.2: Arundhati Reddy drops it up full on the off stump, and Mayers can only drill the drive straight to the waiting hands at cover.
7.3: Arundhati Reddy persists with the full length outside off, drawing another firmly struck push from Mayers that goes straight to the fielder.
7.4: Arundhati Reddy feeds the drive once more, and this time Mayers splits the gap to send it racing away to the deep extra cover boundary.
7.5: Arundhati Reddy drops a low full-toss onto the pitch, and Mayers simply pushes the delivery straight back to the bowler.
7.6: Arundhati Reddy slows it up with a full delivery, allowing Mayers to drag the ball down towards long-on for a single.
8.1: Kranti Gaud spears it outside off, Mayers tries to force the issue over the top, but only picks out Deepti Sharma stationed cleanly at extra cover.
8.2: Kranti Gaud bowls a wide to Nkomo.
8.2: Kranti Gaud spears this length delivery into the pads, and Nkomo clinically glances it through the gap at fine leg to open her account with a boundary.
8.3: Kranti Gaud extracts sharp inward movement off the pitch, forcing Nkomo to defensively turn it toward short mid-wicket for a single.
8.4: 2 runs to Mugeri off Kranti Gaud.
8.5: Kranti Gaud targets the channel outside off, shaping it inwards as Mugeri-Tiripano nudges the ball cleanly toward short mid-wicket for a single.
8.6: Kranti Gaud completes the over, and Nkomo quickly scampers through to backward point to pinch another sharp run.
9.1: Dot ball from Shree Charani to Nkomo.
9.2: Shree Charani tosses it full onto the pads, and Nkomo tucks it away smoothly toward square leg for a single.
9.3: Shree Charani drifts one in, and Mugeri steers it fine past the keeper all the way to the third man fence for four.
9.4: Shree Charani pitches it on a rising length, but Mugeri middles the stroke cleanly to send it racing away to the deep backward point boundary.
9.5: Shree Charani keeps it coming, and Mugeri works this one neatly away toward backward square leg for a single.
9.6: Shree Charani tosses this delivery too full on off stump, allowing Nkomo to drive it down towards long-on for a run.
10.1: Shafali Verma offers a low full toss on middle and leg, glanced away securely through square leg by Josephine Nkomo for a single.
10.2: Shafali Verma tosses it up outside off, and Mugeri strokes the drive cleanly into the off-side to rotate the strike.
10.3: Wide from Shafali Verma to Nkomo.
10.3: Shafali Verma strays down the leg side once more, offering up yet another wide to Nkomo's growing frustration.
10.3: Josephine Nkomo drops to one knee for the sweep, missing entirely as Shafali Verma delivers a third consecutive wide down the leg-side.
10.3: No run for Nkomo off Shafali Verma.
10.4: Shafali Verma slides it through, and Nkomo guides the leather toward third man to pick up a couple of comfortable runs.
10.5: Nkomo does not score off Shafali Verma.
10.6: Shafali Verma zips it through quicker outside off, leaving Josephine Nkomo swinging through empty air on the attempted cut.
11.1: Shree Charani tosses it full around off, catching Mugeri on the pads as the ball sharply spins in, though the stifled appeals find no favour with the umpire.
11.2: Shree Charani floats this full delivery outside off, and Mugeri immediately fetches it out for a reverse-sweep straight to short third.
11.3: Shree Charani floats one into Mugeri, who chips it toward mid-off where Shafali spills a straightforward chance.
11.4: Shree Charani delivers to Nkomo, who reaches out to drive past a full-length dive at cover for no score.
11.5: Shree Charani fires one through with rapid glovework from Richa Ghosh behind the stumps to deny Nkomo any room for scoring.
11.6: Dot ball from Shree Charani to Nkomo.
12.1: Deepti Sharma loops it up to Mugeri, who lofts the delivery aerially toward long-on to comfortably collect a single.
12.2: Deepti Sharma floats this full around middle and leg as Josephine Nkomo works it into the deep for one run.
12.3: Deepti Sharma loops it up to Mugeri, who lofts it toward long-on where Kranti Gaud puts down a chance as the ball races away to the rope.
12.4: Dot ball from Deepti Sharma to Mugeri.
12.5: Deepti Sharma loops it up, and Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano executes a reverse sweep through cover-point to pick up a single.
12.6: Deepti Sharma delivers into Nkomo, who stays back on length outside off to nudge a single through square leg.
13.1: Shree Charani floats one up around off and Josephine Nkomo meets it with a straightforward defensive push straight back down the pitch.
13.2: Shree Charani tosses another full delivery outside off and Josephine Nkomo covers the line to dead-bat it toward cover.
13.3: Shree Charani floats it up, Nkomo marches down the surface and lofts it cleanly toward the long-on boundary.
13.4: Shree Charani beats Mugeri's sweep down the leg-side as the keeper whips the bails off in a flash, but the batter's anchor foot stays firmly grounded.
13.5: Shree Charani loops up a teasing, full delivery outside off that tempts the batter forward.

13.6: Shree Charani tosses this wide outside off, finding Mugeri ready to drive it crisply through the vacant turf as Anushka Sharma launches into a desperate chase from cover to claw the ball back before the ropes.

14.1: Niki Prasad entices Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano with flight outside off, extracting a sharp outside edge that Richa Ghosh safely gathers behind the stumps to break the 45-run partnership on the very first delivery.
14.2: Niki Prasad loops an off-break in to trap Nyasha Gwanzura plumb in front for a golden duck, leaving the bowler on a hat-trick after the review confirms three reds.
14.3: Niki Prasad tosses one up around middle and leg, catching Modester Mupachikwa flush on the pads, but the loud appeal is immediately dismissed by the umpire.
14.4: Niki Prasad keeps the pressure on as Mupachikwa defends this delivery solidly right back down the pitch.
14.5: Niki Prasad slides this full delivery through, allowing Mupachikwa to stroke it down to mid-off and scamper across for a single.
14.6: Josephine Nkomo meets Niki Prasad's full delivery outside off with a flick, straight into the hands of the short mid-wicket fielder.
Niki Prasad strikes twice in the over, leaving ZIMW struggling at 75 for 5!
15.1: Nandani Sharma delivers on a length outside off, allowing Modester Mupachikwa to open the face and guide it down to deep third for a single.
15.2: Nandani Sharma drifts it a touch fuller and takes the pace off on middle and leg, allowing Nkomo to clip it securely into the on-side for a brisk single.
15.3: Nandani Sharma unleashes a lethal yorker targeting the base of the stumps, forcing Modester Mupachikwa into a desperate defensive scrape.
15.4: Nandani Sharma attacks the channel outside off, and Mupachikwa punches it cleanly toward short cover where the fielder executes a sharp stop.
15.5: Four to Nkomo off Nandani Sharma.
15.6: Nandani Sharma drills in a toe-crushing yorker on middle and leg, leaving Nkomo just enough room to dig it out toward long-on for a single.
16.1: Niki Prasad loops one in targeting the pads, and as Nkomo fails to connect with the clip, they scramble through for a sharp leg bye.
16.2: Dot ball from Niki Prasad to Mupachikwa.
16.3: Niki Prasad delivers to Mupachikwa, who works it down smartly to long-off to pick up a single.
16.4: Niki Prasad delivers a length ball straight into the hands of midwicket as Nkomo blocks it away for no run.
16.5: Niki Prasad floats it up and Nkomo nudges the ball towards mid-wicket to scamper through for a sharp single.
16.6: Niki Prasad offers width outside off and Mupachikwa dispatches it powerfully through deep extra cover to find the boundary.
17.1: Arundhati Reddy darts one in on a length, and Josephine Nkomo scuffs an inside edge away to square leg to hustle through for one.
17.2: Arundhati Reddy drops it back of a length outside off, and Mupachikwa punches it cleanly through the off-side to rotate the strike.
17.3: Arundhati Reddy fires in a pinpoint yorker at the toes, squeezed out toward mid-wicket by Josephine Nkomo for a sharp single.
17.4: Arundhati Reddy induces a lap towards short fine, Modester Mupachikwa gambles on a nonexistent run, and Richa Ghosh dismantles the bails to seal a decisive run-out.
17.5: Dot ball from Arundhati Reddy to Michelle Mavunga.
17.6: Arundhati Reddy delivers to Michelle Mavunga, who carves the ball away with authority to pierce the field and race to the deep extra cover boundary.
18.1: Shree Charani pitches it right up, and Nkomo pushes it cleanly down the ground to pick up a single at long-on.
18.2: No run for Michelle Mavunga off Shree Charani.
18.3: Shree Charani strikes with a short delivery as Michelle Mavunga lofts the pull into the deep, where Niki Prasad charges forward to clutch a brilliant low diving catch inches from the turf.
18.4: Shree Charani floats it up outside off, and Francisca Chipare pushes it firmly towards the cover fielder.
18.5: Shree Charani tosses up another loopy delivery, chipped safely into the turf ahead of the converging cover fielder by Francisca Chipare.
18.6: Shree Charani fires a flatter delivery straight into the stumps, safely negotiated into the off-side by Francisca Chipare.
19.1: Kranti Gaud nails a pinpoint yorker angling into middle and leg, squeezed out back down the pitch by Nkomo.
19.2: Kranti Gaud digs it back of a length into middle and leg, and Nkomo swings wildly across the line, skewing a miscue out toward wide mid-on to hustle through for a pair.
19.3: Kranti Gaud tests the length outside the off-stump once more, and Nkomo can only push it straight to mid-off without finding a run.
19.4: Josephine Nkomo drills Kranti Gaud firmly toward mid-off, scrambling back safely just in time as the bails fly off from a sharp throw.
19.5: Kranti Gaud delivers a lethal yorker on off-stump, leaving Josephine Nkomo to jam her bat down in defense and squeeze the missile straight back into the waiting hands of the bowler.

19.6: Kranti Gaud induces the squeeze to backward point, and as the batters scramble for a second following the overthrow, Nandani Sharma and Gaud combine to catch Francisca Chipare short of the crease with a pinpoint underarm run-out that brings the innings to a dramatic close.
0.1: Nyasha Gwanzura strays too wide on the back of a length, allowing Shafali Verma to glide it past third man for four.
0.2: Nyasha Gwanzura corrects the line to a length closer outside off, which Shafali Verma firmly bashes straight to extra cover.
0.3: Nyasha Gwanzura feeds Shafali Verma a length ball on the stumps, and the opener swivels to launch a ferocious slog over deep mid-wicket that slips right through Mayers' hands for a maximum.
0.4: Nyasha Gwanzura digs one in slightly shorter, allowing Shafali Verma to pull it firmly away to deep mid-wicket.
0.5: Nyasha Gwanzura overpitches on the pads, and Smriti Mandhana easily clips it through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
0.6: Nyasha Gwanzura tosses it up on off stump, and Shafali Verma lofts it straight through the line toward long-on.

1.1: Tendai Makusha crosses the crease and oversteps on the opening delivery, offering a short and wide offering outside off that Shafali Verma dabs down to third man for a single, signaling a free hit on the way.
1.1: Smriti Mandhana does not score off Tendai Makusha.

1.2: Tendai Makusha attacks the stumps with a length ball on the free hit, and Smriti Mandhana misjudges the trajectory entirely, losing her shape in a desperate attempt to slog it toward cow corner without making any contact.
1.3: Tendai Makusha delivers to Smriti Mandhana, who taps the ball away towards sweeper cover and scuttles through for a single.
1.4: Tendai Makusha lands it full near the fifth stump as Shafali Verma flashes hard at the away movement and connects with nothing.
1.5: Tendai Makusha offers width outside off and Shafali Verma reaches out to fiercely loft it one bounce over the long-off rope.
1.6: Tendai Makusha digs it in short at the stumps, rushing Shafali Verma into a missed hook as Mupachikwa gathers near her face.
INDW have firmly swung the match their way, cruising at 14 without loss after 1.1 overs and needing just 89 more!
2.1: Nyasha Gwanzura arrows a flat delivery into middle and Smriti Mandhana simply pushes it straight back down the pitch.
2.2: Nyasha Gwanzura tosses it up generously on off stump, inviting Smriti Mandhana to charge down the track and loft it cleanly to long-off.
2.3: Nyasha Gwanzura floats one up and Smriti Mandhana ruthlessly dispatches it away through extra cover.
2.4: Nyasha Gwanzura darts this one quicker towards the off-stump, and Smriti Mandhana cuts it firmly to point.
2.5: Nyasha Gwanzura hits a length that grips off the surface, forcing Smriti Mandhana back to push the ball straight down the pitch to the bowler.
2.6: Nyasha Gwanzura maintains a tight back-of-a-length line, allowing Smriti Mandhana to squeeze her drive cleanly out toward extra cover.
3.1: Tendai Makusha steams in to Shafali Verma, who shuffles across her crease, springs onto the top of the bounce, and flicks the delivery firmly out toward deep midwicket for no run.
3.2: Tendai Makusha floats one right in the slot outside off, and Shafali Verma clubs it away off the bottom edge, muscling the ball all the way over long-off for a maximum.
3.3: Tendai Makusha digs it back, Shafali Verma drops low to pull it toward deep midwicket, racing through for a single.
3.4: Tendai Makusha offers a full toss wide of off stump, punched away toward sweeper cover by Smriti Mandhana for a comfortable single.
3.5: Tendai Makusha extracts extra bounce as this length ball shapes away outside off, leaving Shafali Verma swinging hard into empty air.
3.6: Tendai Makusha drops short outside off, and Shafali Verma capitalizes with a blistering shot square of the wicket for four.
4.1: Nyasha Gwanzura floats it up, and Smriti Mandhana charges down the track, meeting the flight to whip a clean stroke away to the long-on boundary.
4.2: Gwanzura alters her length outside off, but Mandhana reads the shift instantly and drills it past Shafali toward long-off for four.
4.3: Gwanzura drops it short on middle and Mandhana swivels in a flash, pulling it firmly to backward square leg to push the partnership past fifty.
4.4: Gwanzura pushes one slightly short outside off, allowing Mandhana to stay rooted in her crease and punch it cleanly down to long-off.
4.5: Gwanzura bangs it in short, allowing Mandhana to punch it down the ground to long-off for a single.
4.6: Nyasha Gwanzura floats this delivery right into the slot, and Shafali Verma uses her feet to launch it powerfully over extra cover for a spectacular boundary.
5.1: Michelle Mavunga releases, Smriti Mandhana nudges it down the ground toward long-on, and they sprint through for a single.
5.2: Michelle Mavunga floats one slower outside the off stump, tempting Shafali Verma into a massive lofted drive down the ground that completely bypasses the flailing blade for a dot ball.
5.3: Michelle Mavunga drops this wide outside off, and Shafali Verma reaches out to brutally slash it square through the off-side for four.
5.4: Michelle Mavunga strays too full onto the pads, allowing Shafali Verma to instinctively paddle it airborne toward backward square leg for another boundary.
5.5: Michelle Mavunga serves up an overpitched delivery in the slot, which Shafali Verma cleanly launches over wide long-off for a maximum.
5.6: Shafali Verma does not score off Michelle Mavunga.
6.1: Olinder Chare drops it too full on middle, and Smriti Mandhana gracefully eases it down to long-on for a single.
6.2: Olinder Chare fires it flatter and quicker, allowing Shafali Verma to shift back and cut it square on the off-side.
6.3: Olinder Chare darts a quick one onto the pads, tucked away comfortably by Smriti Mandhana toward deep mid-wicket.
6.4: Olinder Chare tosses it up on off, prompting Shafali Verma to charge down the track and drill it straight to long-on.
6.5: Olinder Chare loops it up, and Smriti Mandhana skips down the track to launch a colossal eighty-seven metre maximum sailing over deep mid-wicket.
6.6: Olinder Chare fires one in on a length outside off, and Smriti Mandhana drives it cleanly down to long-off for a single.
7.1: Beloved Biza drifts one flatter through the air outside off, allowing Smriti Mandhana to step back and punch it through the ring toward wide long-off for a comfortable single.
7.2: Beloved Biza darts it in short, and Shafali Verma swivels back, muscling the pull away toward wide long-on to comfortably collect a single.
7.3: Beloved Biza attacks the middle and leg corridor with a subtle length variation, deftly clipped through mid-wicket by Smriti Mandhana to turn the strike over.
7.4: Shafali Verma charges down the pitch to conquer a blistering twenty-four-ball fifty, launching Beloved Biza high over the deep mid-wicket boundary for a towering six.
7.5: Beloved Biza strikes immediately as Shafali Verma skies her ambitious stroke straight to Tendai Makusha, departing for a brilliant 55 from 25 deliveries.
7.6: Beloved Biza angles it slightly short on middle and leg, leaving Anushka Sharma to work the ball cleanly into the mid-wicket region for a dot.
8.1: Olinder Chare loops this one up around off stump, and Smriti Mandhana meets it cleanly, driving through the line down to long-off to rotate the strike.
8.2: Chare drops it a fraction fuller outside the off stump, prompting Anushka Sharma to stroke the ball crisply into the mid-off region.
8.3: Chare keeps it full and probes the channel around off, drawing a solid defensive prod from Anushka Sharma straight to mid-on.
8.4: Olinder Chare loops this full delivery around off, allowing Anushka Sharma to punch it firmly towards long-off for a single and get off the mark.
8.5: Olinder Chare delivers to Smriti Mandhana, who charges down the track and launches the ball cleanly over extra cover for six to seal the victory for India.
